#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Reuse the exact native CLI, credential scrubbing, and in-memory audit helpers.
from pathlib import Path
helper_source=Path('/tmp/stackd_dashboards_authority_retry_probe.py').read_text()
exec(compile(helper_source.split('\n# The first capture',1)[0],'/tmp/stackd_dashboards_authority_retry_probe.py','exec'))
primary=json.loads(OUT.read_text())
OUT=Path('/tmp/stackd_dashboards_authority_list_capture.json')
PREFIX=primary['prefix'];ACTOR=primary['actor_arn']
CAP={'region':REGION,'caller_account':ACCOUNT,'actor_arn':ACTOR,'prefix':PREFIX,'sources':[{'path':'/tmp/stackd_dashboards_authority_list_probe.py','content':Path('/tmp/stackd_dashboards_authority_list_probe.py').read_text()}],'observations':[],'cleanup':[],'cleanup_verification':{},'evidence_boundaries':['Supplemental ListDashboards resource-ARN wildcard discrimination; only sessions against the parent-owned role are created.'],'audit':{'matched_events':[],'objects':[]}}
OWN={'bucket':PREFIX+'-audit','role_arn':'arn:aws:iam::'+ACCOUNT+':role/'+PREFIX+'-broad'}
S3=boto3.client('s3',region_name=REGION)
for label,resource in [('all-dashboard-arn','arn:aws:cloudwatch::'+ACCOUNT+':dashboard/*'),('owned-dashboard-prefix-arn','arn:aws:cloudwatch::'+ACCOUNT+':dashboard/'+PREFIX+'*'),('regional-all-dashboard-arn','arn:aws:cloudwatch:'+REGION+':'+ACCOUNT+':dashboard/*')]:
    e,actor=assume('list-'+label,[allow(['cloudwatch:ListDashboards'],resource)])
    call('list-'+label,'cloudwatch','list-dashboards',{'DashboardNamePrefix':PREFIX},env=e,actor=actor)
labels=[o['label'] for o in CAP['observations'] if o['service']=='cloudwatch']
CAP['audit']['unmatched_labels']=wait_audit(labels,300)
CAP['cleanup_verification']={'owns_no_durable_resources':True,'parent_role_cleanup_required':OWN['role_arn']}
save()
print('Supplement complete',flush=True)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import json,re
from pathlib import Path
out=Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/testdata/aws/cloudwatch/dashboards_authority.json')
cap=json.loads(out.read_text())
extra=json.loads(Path('/tmp/stackd_dashboards_authority_list_capture.json').read_text())
assert cap['cleanup_verification']['all_verified']
assert all(p['cleanup_verification']['all_verified'] for p in cap.get('prior_attempts',[]))
assert not extra['audit']['unmatched_labels']
assert cap['prefix']==extra['prefix']
assert not cap.get('probe_error')
for ob in extra['observations']:
    ob['label']='supplemental-'+ob['label']
for m in extra['audit']['matched_events']:
    m['label']='supplemental-'+m['label']
cap['observations'].extend(extra['observations'])
cap['observations'].sort(key=lambda o:o['request_started_ms'])
cap['sources'].extend(extra['sources'])
cap['sources'].append({'path':'/tmp/stackd_dashboards_authority_finalize.py','content':Path('/tmp/stackd_dashboards_authority_finalize.py').read_text()})
cap['audit']['matched_events'].extend(extra['audit']['matched_events'])
known_objects={o['key']:o for o in cap['audit']['objects']}
for ob in extra['audit']['objects']:
    if ob['key'] not in known_objects:
        cap['audit']['objects'].append(ob);known_objects[ob['key']]=ob
    else:
        known_objects[ob['key']]['matched_count']+=ob['matched_count']
cap['evidence_boundaries'].extend(extra['evidence_boundaries'])
cap['evidence_boundaries'].extend([
    'The first attempt was interrupted while waiting for its initial startup marker and fully cleaned. It remains under prior_attempts. The successful attempt retried fresh PutDashboard replacements until an exact correlated record established readiness; the initial startup marker remained unmatched.',
    'Supplemental ListDashboards session controls reused the primary broad role without creating any durable resources. Primary cleanup removed and verified that role and its inline policy.',
    'All matrix dashboard operations, including success, authorization denial and service-validation errors, correlated to delivered CloudTrail records. Unmatched pre-readiness markers remain uncertainty, not evidence of an unlogged action.',
    'Native CLI code ResourceNotFound accompanies HTTP404 and the wire type com.amazonaws.cloudwatch.v2010_08_01#DashboardNotFoundError. Cleanup absence uses the wire type and status rather than a guessed CLI alias.'
])
tags=json.loads(Path('/tmp/stackd_dashboards_authority_tags_capture.json').read_text())
assert tags['cleanup_verification']['all_verified']
assert not tags.get('probe_error')
assert tags['prefix']==cap['prefix']
for ob in tags['observations']+tags['cleanup']:
    ob['label']='tags-'+ob['label']
for m in tags['audit']['matched_events']:
    m['label']='tags-'+m['label']
cap['observations'].extend(tags['observations'])
cap['cleanup'].extend(tags['cleanup'])
cap['observations'].sort(key=lambda o:o['request_started_ms'])
cap['cleanup'].sort(key=lambda o:o['request_started_ms'])
cap['sources'].extend(tags['sources'])
cap['cleanup_verification']['supplemental-create-tags']=tags['cleanup_verification']
cap['audit']['matched_events'].extend(tags['audit']['matched_events'])
cap['audit']['unmatched_labels'].extend('tags-'+label for label in tags['audit']['unmatched_labels'])
for ob in tags['audit']['objects']:
    if ob['key'] not in known_objects:
        cap['audit']['objects'].append(ob);known_objects[ob['key']]=ob
    else:
        known_objects[ob['key']]['matched_count']+=ob['matched_count']
cap['evidence_boundaries'].extend(tags['evidence_boundaries'])
cap['evidence_boundaries'].append('The late supplemental create-time Tags control used a 30-second bounded audit wait before the established trail was cleaned. Unmatched tags-* observations are explicitly inconclusive for CloudTrail, while their native API responses and cleanup remain observed.')
obs={o['label']:o for o in cap['observations']}
assert len(obs)==len(cap['observations'])
matched=set()
for m in cap['audit']['matched_events']:
    assert m['label'] in obs
    assert m['event']['requestID']==obs[m['label']]['result']['request_id']
    matched.add(m['label'])
for ob in cap['observations']:
    for key in ('label','service','operation','input','request_started_ms','caller_account','actor_arn','result'):assert key in ob
    assert ob['actor_arn'] and ob['caller_account']=='000000000000'
    if ob['service']=='cloudwatch' and not ob['label'].startswith(('readiness-','tags-')):assert ob['label'] in matched
matrix_start=min(ob['request_started_ms'] for ob in cap['observations'] if ob['label']=='create-second-dashboard')
assert cap['audit']['readiness']['completed_ms']<=matrix_start
serialized=json.dumps(cap,indent=2)+'\n'
assert not re.search(r'\b(?:AKIA|ASIA)[A-Z0-9]{16}\b',serialized)
out.write_text(serialized)
for name in ('stackd_dashboards_authority_probe.py','stackd_dashboards_authority_scenario.py','stackd_dashboards_authority_retry_probe.py','stackd_dashboards_authority_list_probe.py','stackd_dashboards_authority_list_capture.json','stackd_dashboards_authority_tags_probe.py','stackd_dashboards_authority_tags_capture.json','stackd_dashboards_authority_finalize.py'):
    Path('/tmp',name).unlink()
print(json.dumps({'observations':len(cap['observations']),'cleanup_observations':len(cap['cleanup']),'matched_events':len(cap['audit']['matched_events']),'unmatched_labels':cap['audit']['unmatched_labels'],'cleanup_verified':cap['cleanup_verification']['all_verified'],'prior_cleanup_verified':all(p['cleanup_verification']['all_verified'] for p in cap.get('prior_attempts',[]))},indent=2))

#!/usr/bin/env python3
from pathlib import Path
helper_source=Path('/tmp/stackd_dashboards_authority_retry_probe.py').read_text()
exec(compile(helper_source.split('\n# The first capture',1)[0],'/tmp/stackd_dashboards_authority_retry_probe.py','exec'))
primary=json.loads(OUT.read_text())
OUT=Path('/tmp/stackd_dashboards_authority_tags_capture.json')
PREFIX=primary['prefix'];ACTOR=primary['actor_arn'];A=PREFIX+'-a';ARN='arn:aws:cloudwatch::'+ACCOUNT+':dashboard/'+A
CAP={'region':REGION,'caller_account':ACCOUNT,'actor_arn':ACTOR,'prefix':PREFIX,'sources':[{'path':'/tmp/stackd_dashboards_authority_tags_probe.py','content':Path('/tmp/stackd_dashboards_authority_tags_probe.py').read_text()}],'observations':[],'cleanup':[],'cleanup_verification':{},'evidence_boundaries':['Supplemental create-time Tags authority control runs after both dashboard names were deleted; GetDashboard first proves A absent. No new dashboard name is introduced.'],'audit':{'matched_events':[],'objects':[]}}
OWN={'bucket':PREFIX+'-audit','role_arn':'arn:aws:iam::'+ACCOUNT+':role/'+PREFIX+'-id-put'}
S3=boto3.client('s3',region_name=REGION)
role=None
try:
    before=call('before-create-tags-dashboard-absent','cloudwatch','get-dashboard',{'DashboardName':A})
    assert before.get('http_status')==404
    e,actor=assume('put-only-create-tags',None)
    params={'DashboardName':A,'DashboardBody':'{"widgets":[]}','Tags':[{'Key':'Probe','Value':PREFIX}]}
    r=call('put-only-create-tags','cloudwatch','put-dashboard',params,env=e,actor=actor)
    if r['code']!='Success':
        role=PREFIX+'-put-and-tag'
        trust=policy([{'Effect':'Allow','Principal':{'AWS':ACTOR},'Action':'sts:AssumeRole'}])
        rr=req('create-put-and-tag-role','iam','create-role',{'RoleName':role,'AssumeRolePolicyDocument':trust})
        req('put-and-tag-role-policy','iam','put-role-policy',{'RoleName':role,'PolicyName':'dashboard-authority','PolicyDocument':policy([allow(['cloudwatch:PutDashboard','cloudwatch:TagResource'],ARN)])})
        time.sleep(15)
        e,actor=assume('put-and-tag-create-tags',None,rr['Role']['Arn'])
        call('put-and-tag-create-tags','cloudwatch','put-dashboard',params,env=e,actor=actor)
    call('owner-get-created-tagged-dashboard','cloudwatch','get-dashboard',{'DashboardName':A})
    call('owner-list-created-dashboard-tags','cloudwatch','list-tags-for-resource',{'ResourceARN':ARN})
    CAP['audit']['unmatched_labels']=wait_audit([o['label'] for o in CAP['observations'] if o['service']=='cloudwatch'],30)
except BaseException as exc:
    CAP['probe_error']={'type':type(exc).__name__,'message':str(exc)}
finally:
    call('cleanup-create-tags-dashboard','cloudwatch','delete-dashboards',{'DashboardNames':[A]},cleanup=True)
    r=call('verify-create-tags-dashboard-absent','cloudwatch','get-dashboard',{'DashboardName':A},cleanup=True)
    CAP['cleanup_verification']['dashboard']=r.get('http_status')==404 and r.get('output',{}).get('__type','').endswith('#DashboardNotFoundError')
    if role:
        call('cleanup-put-and-tag-policy','iam','delete-role-policy',{'RoleName':role,'PolicyName':'dashboard-authority'},cleanup=True)
        p=call('verify-put-and-tag-policies-empty','iam','list-role-policies',{'RoleName':role},cleanup=True)
        CAP['cleanup_verification']['role-policies']=p['code']=='Success' and p['output'].get('PolicyNames')==[]
        call('cleanup-put-and-tag-role','iam','delete-role',{'RoleName':role},cleanup=True)
        r=call('verify-put-and-tag-role-absent','iam','get-role',{'RoleName':role},cleanup=True)
        CAP['cleanup_verification']['role']=r['code']=='NoSuchEntity'
    CAP['cleanup_verification']['all_verified']=all(CAP['cleanup_verification'].values());save()
    print('Tags control complete',flush=True)
